Package com.nexuslink.ui.hint

package com.nexuslink.ui.hint
  • Class
    Description
    EmptyState
    A friendly "nothing here yet" placeholder for an empty panel: a large muted icon, a headline, a one-line hint, and an optional call-to-action button.
    ErrorHelp
    Pure mapping from an error message to the best Help navigation target (troubleshooting#anchor).
    ErrorHelpLink
    A "What does this mean?" hyperlink shown next to an error message.
    FirstRunOverlay
    A step-by-step first-run onboarding overlay: a dimmed scrim with a centred card that walks the user through the app in a few slides, with Back / Next, a Skip escape, and a Don't show this again checkbox.
    FirstRunOverlay.Step
    One onboarding slide.
    HelpButton
    A small circular ? button that opens the Help dialog at a chosen anchor.
    OnboardingPrefs
    Persists whether the first-run onboarding overlay has been dismissed, so it appears only once (unless the user re-opens it from Help).
    TooltipPlus
    "Tooltip-plus": attaches a richer hover tooltip to a field and wires F1 (while the field is focused) to open contextual help.

NexusLink — one console, every protocol, zero context switching.
